users_role_scope.name: users_role_scope
users_role_scope.value:
(
        (
          "users"."role" = 'dispatcher'
          and "users"."outlet_id" is null
          and "users"."vehicle_id" is null
        )
        or (
          "users"."role" = 'loader'
          and "users"."depot_id" is not null
          and "users"."outlet_id" is null
          and "users"."vehicle_id" is null
        )
        or (
          "users"."role" = 'driver'
          and "users"."vehicle_id" is not null
          and "users"."outlet_id" is null
          and "users"."depot_id" is null
        )
        or (
          "users"."role" = 'store_manager'
          and "users"."outlet_id" is not null
          and "users"."depot_id" is null
          and "users"."vehicle_id" is null
        )
      )

loading_issues_acknowledgement.name: loading_issues_acknowledgement
loading_issues_acknowledgement.value:
(
        ("loading_issues"."acknowledged_by" is null and "loading_issues"."acknowledged_at" is null)
        or ("loading_issues"."acknowledged_by" is not null and "loading_issues"."acknowledged_at" is not null)
      )

planning_runs_publish_fields.name: planning_runs_publish_fields
planning_runs_publish_fields.value:
(
        ("planning_runs"."status" = 'open' and "planning_runs"."published_at" is null and "planning_runs"."published_by" is null)
        or (
          "planning_runs"."status" = 'published'
          and "planning_runs"."published_at" is not null
          and "planning_runs"."published_by" is not null
        )
      )

outlets_mall_window_pair.name: outlets_mall_window_pair
outlets_mall_window_pair.value:
(
        ("outlets"."mall_window_open" is null and "outlets"."mall_window_close" is null)
        or (
          "outlets"."mall_window_open" is not null
          and "outlets"."mall_window_close" is not null
          and "outlets"."mall_window_open" < "outlets"."mall_window_close"
        )
      )

issues_resolution.name: issues_resolution
issues_resolution.value:
(
        ("issues"."status" = 'open' and "issues"."resolved_by" is null and "issues"."resolved_at" is null)
        or ("issues"."status" = 'resolved' and "issues"."resolved_by" is not null and "issues"."resolved_at" is not null)
      )
